endpointKindReplay.decision: Rejected: the endpoint arguments are not consumed by the native router yet, so the trial was behaviorally a no-op. Do not carry dead plumbing into the device candidate.

fastOnDeviceCandidate.change: Pack fuel planning treats the waypoint only as a forward-direction guide. Partial windows select and prove one legal next station in the departure pack, return only the start-to-pump route, and start the next window from that pump. Fast fuel hops avoid the duplicate reverse cap flood, use a bounded snap radius, prewarm the edge index after location/pack warmup, skip unused urban-box ranking for partial windows, and retain a coarser meaningful-loop pass plus heading-reversal stripping. Normal route planning keeps full loop pruning and fresh-seed variation.

hostFixture.searchMode: one Dirt corridor, no repair ladder, 1.8s absolute cutoff
hostFixture.scope: macOS native facade using the current OnDeviceRouter source; not physical-phone qualification

fastOnDeviceCandidate.errorContract: Returns fuel_fast_path_no_qualified_route with windowComplete=false only when no legal next station hop is proven; this is a station-hop failure, not evidence that the pack has no fuel stations.
fastOnDeviceCandidate.correctnessGate: Each returned first hop is a profile route with legal snapping/turn checks, bounded by the candidate-specific cap inside the rider range, and rejected when the mapped forecourt is more than 150m from the returned road endpoint. The next window must prove the following hop. Strict source-walk fuel continuity still remains required for the soft station connector.

routeVariance.result: three distinct Dirt geometries for identical endpoints; fresh pin builds also receive distinct seeds and saved routes remain reproducible

focusedGate.scope: PackFirstRoutingTests + ItineraryBuilderTests + ItineraryRebuildTests; includes identical-pin fresh-seed assertion

fastOnDeviceCandidate.limitation: The partial station connector remains labelled soft-stitch until customer-access edges are authored and the strict source-walk audit accepts it. The private iPhone 17 simulator NS→NB two-window probe succeeds for Cleanest, Dirt, and Balanced with zero residual loops over the fast 100 m audit threshold; no physical-device run has been made.

concurrency.interpretation: Single-process and four-way host runs meet the 1.8s cutoff. Eight-way contention on one Mac exceeds it while each process remains under 95 MiB RSS; this is CPU contention, not graph-memory growth.
